name: 75013 · Allen, TX
findings: ZIP 75013 (Allen) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75013 (Allen) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75013 (Allen) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
